conditions.reason: The scope word limited the taxonomy rule to gzkit's own ADRs. The replacement takes it out ('New ADRs are') so the rule covers every project, following the operator ruling of 2026-11-27 (GHI #1402): 'we must not permit adopters to use them'.

The locative scope limited the closure to the gzkit repository. The replacement swaps it for the wider scope 'in every project, adopters included', following the operator ruling of 2026-11-27 (GHI #1402) that adopters may not use foundation ADRs.
The adopter exemption is revoked by the operator ruling of 2026-11-27 (GHI #1402), 'we must not permit adopters to use them'. The replacement states the opposite: 'adopters included'.
